portraits.prompt:
Create ONE original square fantasy RPG character portrait PNG, 1024x1024. Reference image is a style-study contact sheet only: retain black background, chest-up framing, readable silhouettes and crisp pixel clusters; do NOT copy any face, clothing, pose or assembled body from it. Design the whole character together, natural integrated head-neck-shoulder anatomy. Improved sophisticated hand-placed pixel art, approximately 176x176 logical pixel detail enlarged with hard square edges, coherent 32-48 color palette with controlled ramps, no blur, no photorealism, no painterly smooth gradients, no noise, no text, no borders. Face must remain expressive when the image is rendered at 88x88. Bold large readable forms, head occupies about 40 percent of image height, ample space for ears/hair/horns and shoulders; bottom crops naturally at lower chest. Tasteful functional fantasy clothing. One person only. Pure black backdrop. Original character, no copied assets. 
SUBJECT: Adult Black human woman wizard, about 50, rich dark brown skin, broad nose, full lips, tightly coiled silver-black hair worn in a rounded high natural updo. Long oval face, thoughtful asymmetrical smile, lean sloping shoulders. Three-quarter view facing left, gaze toward viewer. Ink-blue high-collared academic robe with broad copper edging, ochre shoulder sash, small geometric bronze clasp; one hand supports a closed weathered grimoire at bottom of frame. Reserved confidence, wise lively eyes. Warm face lighting, restrained cyan magical edge on book. No hat, no armor.
